description: A man in a pale lab coat, seen from behind in profile, writes with chalk on a large dark chalkboard in a dim laboratory. The board holds a grid of chalk marks, mostly rune-like glyphs, but the top rows plainly read as characters such as U33, AIC, H33, CnC, L33 and 333. A string of beads of varied shapes hangs at the right edge of the board. Shelves of books and glassware sit in the shadows. The painting runs edge to edge; only the board's own wooden frame is part of the scene.
reason: The chalkboard grid includes readable letters and numbers (e.g. 'U33', 'AIC', 'H33', '333', 'CnC'). Repaint the grid with purely abstract, non-letter, non-numeral marks.
